theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_dr_multivector_dual_norm
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ N : MultiVector P n → ℝ, Continuous N ∧ (∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, 0 ≤ N ζ) ∧ (∀ (ζ : MultiVector P n) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ α| ≤ N ζ * covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ β = N ζ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
